default_in_repayment.text:
In our opinion and according to the information and explanations given to us, moneys raised by way of initial public offer during the year, have been, prima facie, applied by the Company for the purposes for which they were raised. 

The total monies aggregating Rs. 25,498.00 lakhs raised during the year, a sum of Rs. 13,405.83 lakhs was utilised by the Company for the purpose for which it was raised during the current year. Pending utilization, Rs. 11,657.00 lakhs are temporarily invested in Fixed Deposits, Rs. 150.95 lakhs is held in the Company's Monitoring Account, while the balance amount is of Rs. 284.15 Lakhs held in the Company's Escrow Account.


The Company has not made any preferential allotment or private placement of shares or fully or partially or optionally convertible debentures during the year. Accordingly, the reporting under Clause 3(x) (b) of the Order is not applicable to the Company.

fraud.text:
(a)	According to the information and explanation given to us no material fraud by the Company or on the Company by its officers or employees, noticed or reported during the course of our audit, nor have been informed of such cases by the management.
(b)	According to the information and explanations given to us, no report under sub-section (12) of Section 143 of the Act has been filed by the auditors in Form ADT-4 as prescribed under Rule 13 of the Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014 with the Central Government. 


(c)	According to the information and explanation given to us the Company has not received any whistle-blower complaints during the year hence para 3(xi)(c) of the Order is not applicable.

operating_notes.text: The company operates as a single reportable segment: manufacturing of long and flat stainless-steel products.
IPO proceeds of ₹254.98 Cr were 53% utilised by March 31, 2026, with ₹116.57 Cr temporarily in fixed deposits.
FY26 inventory build absorbed ₹49.26 Cr of cash, lifting inventories to ₹181.78 Cr from ₹132.52 Cr.
FY26 revenue from operations crossed ₹1,000 crore, standing at ₹1,006.96 crore.
Unutilised IPO proceeds stood at ₹21.33 crore as of September 30, 2026, with capex for forward integration into stainless steel seamless pipes delayed.

timeline.summary: Rajputana Stainless submitted its Q4FY26 Monitoring Agency Report showing ₹119.64 crore of unutilised IPO proceeds.
Rajputana Stainless reported FY26 revenue of ₹1,006.96 crore and a 25.01% increase in net profit to ₹49.82 crore, recommending a final dividend of ₹0.50 per share.
Rajputana Stainless Limited will host an earnings conference call for analysts and investors on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at 3:00 PM IST.
Rajputana Stainless submitted its Q2FY27 Monitoring Agency Report showing ₹21.33 crore of unutilised IPO proceeds.
